g.text: Examplestad is a small, entirely fictional harbour town on the coast of Imaginaria, known
for its lighthouse walks and fish soup.
The town grew around a fishing harbour. Summers are mild and wint…
Most sights are within walking distance of the harbour.
A single heritage tram line runs from the station to the lighthou…
Bicycles can be rented at the station.
Fish soup is the local speciality.
Otherville – a day trip by ferry.
